# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1637
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1637
- **Title**: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)
- **Author**: IstiN
- **Branch**: `crap4dart-0142-broken-goldens` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +64
- **Deletions**: -39
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T20:12:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:42:31Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

- **Author**: IstiN
- **Branch**: `crap4dart-0142-broken-goldens` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +64
- **Deletions**: -39
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T20:12:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:42:31Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):

The `CRAP + duplication` job failed on this PR's CI run ([run 38802108913](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38802108913)) exactly at this step:

```

90.00    0.0  N/A    9  (top-level)._typeName           lib/src/model_roles/providers_queue.dart:629
Max CRAP: 90.00 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)
Process completed with exit code 2.
```

The 12.0 threshold (and the flutter_app 30.0) were measured on the 0.11.x census. crap4dart 0.14.2 changed the census semantics — the two offenders measure CC 9 at 0.0% coverage here (both under 0.11.x kept the repo at ≤ 12.0 on the same merged lcov; `parseTuiMouseMode` is a switch *expression* whose or-patterns now appear to count as branches, and/or the lcov coverage join now attributes 0% to functions the old version credited). `analyze` then exits 2, which also means the downstream `Quality gates (check --baseline)` step never ran in CI (I ran it locally on 0.14.2: it passes — loc + duplication baseline + broken_goldens 4/4 — so the ratchet is the only red).

The pixel-gate goal of this PR is fine and verified (see general comment) — this failure is purely the analyzer-version side effect on the ratchet. Fix options:

1. Re-measure both ratchets under 0.14.2 and repin — but `scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down` rejects raised thresholds, and the README badge must be synced, so this needs the documented owner-exception path (precedent: the gh-992 temp raise).
2. Or confirm with upstream whether the 0.14.x census/coverage-join change is intended (it looks like a regression for switch-or-pattern functions) and gate the ratchet on the version the thresholds were measured with until reconciled.

Either way the PR as-pinned cannot merge: this is a required red job introduced by this diff.

### Thread 2 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
🚨 **BLOCKING: app CRAP ratchet is red under the new pin — `156.00 > 30.0`**

CRAP threshold exceeded: 156.00 > 30.0

[PASS] broken_goldens: 225 golden images clean   (severity: error, 1 documented residual excluded)
Gates: 3 passed, 3 warned, 20 skipped  → exit 0
```

so the detector flip itself is sound — only the ratchet thresholds (30.0, measured on 0.11.x) don't transfer to the 0.14.x census. Re-measure and repin via the owner-exception path (the `--only-down` guard rejects plain raises), or reconcile the analyzer change upstream first.

### Thread 3 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
💡 **SUGGESTION: harden the JSON violation schema access**

Two small robustness nits in the new JSON path:

1. `v["file"]` raises `KeyError` (traceback, not the script's `SystemExit` idiom) if a future report omits the key. `v.get("file", "")` degrades gracefully and still counts the violation via `setdefault(Path("").name, ...)` — or skip the entry.

If the JSON parses as a dict but the schema drifts (`gates` renamed, `violations` renamed), `violations` ends up empty and — with the detector's rc=2 for findings — the `proc.returncode not in (0, 2)` guard does not fire, so the scoreboard silently reports everything clean. `--expect-fixed` still fails loudly (the `detect` targets miss), and the regression count prints 0/40, but a bare `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py` run would lie. # pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

The 12.0 threshold (and the flutter_app 30.0) were measured on the 0.11.x census. crap4dart 0.14.2 changed the census semantics — the two offenders measure CC 9 at 0.0% coverage here (both under 0.11.x kept the repo at ≤ 12.0 on the same merged lcov; `parseTuiMouseMode` is a switch *expression* whose or-patterns now appear to count as branches, and/or the lcov coverage join now attributes 0% to functions the old version credited). `analyze` then exits 2, which also means the downstream `Quality gates (check --baseline)` step never ran in CI (I ran it locally on 0.14.2: it passes — loc + duplication baseline + broken_goldens 4/4 — so the ratchet is the only red).

1. Re-measure both ratchets under 0.14.2 and repin — but `scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down` rejects raised thresholds, and the README badge must be synced, so this needs the documented owner-exception path (precedent: the gh-992 temp raise).

[PASS] broken_goldens: 225 golden images clean   (severity: error, 1 documented residual excluded)

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

The 12.0 threshold (and the flutter_app 30.0) were measured on the 0.11.x census. crap4dart 0.14.2 changed the census semantics — the two offenders measure CC 9 at 0.0% coverage here (both under 0.11.x kept the repo at ≤ 12.0 on the same merged lcov; `parseTuiMouseMode` is a switch *expression* whose or-patterns now appear to count as branches, and/or the lcov coverage join now attributes 0% to functions the old version credited). `analyze` then exits 2, which also means the downstream `Quality gates (check --baseline)` step never ran in CI (I ran it locally on 0.14.2: it passes — loc + duplication baseline + broken_goldens 4/4 — so the ratchet is the only red).

[PASS] broken_goldens: 225 golden images clean   (severity: error, 1 documented residual excluded)

### Thread 3 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
💡 **SUGGESTION: harden the JSON violation schema access**

Two small robustness nits in the new JSON path:

1. `v["file"]` raises `KeyError` (traceback, not the script's `SystemExit` idiom) if a future report omits the key. `v.get("file", "")` degrades gracefully and still counts the violation via `setdefault(Path("").name, ...)` — or skip the entry.

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

The 12.0 threshold (and the flutter_app 30.0) were measured on the 0.11.x census. crap4dart 0.14.2 changed the census semantics — the two offenders measure CC 9 at 0.0% coverage here (both under 0.11.x kept the repo at ≤ 12.0 on the same merged lcov; `parseTuiMouseMode` is a switch *expression* whose or-patterns now appear to count as branches, and/or the lcov coverage join now attributes 0% to functions the old version credited). `analyze` then exits 2, which also means the downstream `Quality gates (check --baseline)` step never ran in CI (I ran it locally on 0.14.2: it passes — loc + duplication baseline + broken_goldens 4/4 — so the ratchet is the only red).

1. Re-measure both ratchets under 0.14.2 and repin — but `scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down` rejects raised thresholds, and the README badge must be synced, so this needs the documented owner-exception path (precedent: the gh-992 temp raise).

[PASS] broken_goldens: 225 golden images clean   (severity: error, 1 documented residual excluded)

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          mkdir -p coverage

      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: 0.9.5+ carries the gate framework (broken_goldens
          # et al.); 0.2.1 knew only the CRAP ratchet. Both configs set
          # coverage.run_tests: false — the merged shard lcov above is the

          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 renamed-clone detection
          # (duplication.ignore_locals) + gate baselines; the
          # duplication gate config throws on older parsers (unknown
          # keys are a ConfigException).
          # Bounded (rework review): a floating >= would auto-adopt
          # 0.12.0+ with no repo change — bump the ceiling deliberately.
          # crap4dart#3/#4 (2026-10-15): >=0.14.2 — the broken_goldens
          # detector fixes (checkmark V, yellow-on-dark digits, hollow
          # boxes, solid glyph runs); the configs now rely on 0.14.2
          # behaviour (severity: error, old excludes dropped).
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.14.2 <0.15.0"
          dart pub global run crap4dart analyze

      - name: Quality gates (broken goldens + Type-2 duplication, issue 1106)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: dart pub global run crap4dart check --baseline

        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          dart run scripts/gen_session_fixture.dart \
            --records 100000 --out /tmp/big-session.jsonl \

sdk: stable
      - name: Pub cache (crap4dart)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: pub-crap4dart-${{ runner.os }}
          restore-keys: pub-crap4dart-${{ runner.os }}-
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        with:
          pattern: app-coverage-shard-*
          path: app-coverage-shards
      - name: Merge shard coverage (union DA hits per file, NOT cat)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          count=$(ls app-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
          if [ "$count" != "2" ]; then
            echo "::error::expected 2 app shard coverage reports, got $count"
            exit 1
          fi
          mkdir -p flutter_app/coverage
          python3 scripts/merge_lcov.py -o flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info \
            app-coverage-shards/*/lcov.info
      - name: Config guards — badge sync, exclude parity, only-down (AC1/E1/AC3)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          BASE_SHA="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}"
          [ -n "$BASE_SHA" ] || BASE_SHA=HEAD~1
          python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down "$BASE_SHA"
      - name: CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          # Issue #447: pin bumped 0.2.1 → >=0.9.5 for the gate framework.
          # gh-1061: >=0.10.0 (analyzer 14.4 refresh).
          # gh-1106: >=0.11.0 — Type-2 duplication gate.
          # crap4dart#3/#4 (2026-10-15): >=0.14.2 <0.15.0 — same bounded
          # pin as the core job; the broken_goldens detector fixes the
          # flipped configs rely on.
          # coverage.run_tests: false in both configs — the merged shard
          # lcov above is the source; never re-run the suite here.
          dart pub global activate crap4dart ">=0.14.2 <0.15.0"
          cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart analyze --format json > crap_report.json

      # Issue #490 AC2: publish the ranked CRAP JSON even when the ratchet
      # is red (analyze writes the report to stdout before its non-zero
      # exit) — descents rank from this artifact, never from a local
      # ad-hoc run.
      - name: Upload crap_report.json artifact (issue 490 AC2)
        if: always() && (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true')
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # Shard-manifest assert (AC1/E4): union of the 3 selections == the
      # full non-golden suite, pairwise disjoint, ZERO golden leakage —
      # fails loudly on manifest drift or a golden-pattern rename before
      # any test runs. Pure python, no flutter needed.
      - name: Assert shard manifest (union/disjoint/no-goldens)
        working-directory: packages/fa_ui
        run: >-
          python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py
          ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1637
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1637
- **Title**: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)
- **Author**: IstiN
- **Branch**: `crap4dart-0142-broken-goldens` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 4
- **Additions**: +64
- **Deletions**: -39
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T20:12:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:42:31Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

Upstream issue comments carry the full fix breakdown.

```

```

The 12.0 threshold (and the flutter_app 30.0) were measured on the 0.11.x census. crap4dart 0.14.2 changed the census semantics — the two offenders measure CC 9 at 0.0% coverage here (both under 0.11.x kept the repo at ≤ 12.0 on the same merged lcov; `parseTuiMouseMode` is a switch *expression* whose or-patterns now appear to count as branches, and/or the lcov coverage join now attributes 0% to functions the old version credited). `analyze` then exits 2, which also means the downstream `Quality gates (check --baseline)` step never ran in CI (I ran it locally on 0.14.2: it passes — loc + duplication baseline + broken_goldens 4/4 — so the ratchet is the only red).

1. Re-measure both ratchets under 0.14.2 and repin — but `scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down` rejects raised thresholds, and the README badge must be synced, so this needs the documented owner-exception path (precedent: the gh-992 temp raise).
2. Or confirm with upstream whether the 0.14.x census/coverage-join change is intended (it looks like a regression for switch-or-pattern functions) and gate the ratchet on the version the thresholds were measured with until reconciled.

Either way the PR as-pinned cannot merge: this is a required red job introduced by this diff.

### Thread 2 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
🚨 **BLOCKING: app CRAP ratchet is red under the new pin — `156.00 > 30.0`**

[PASS] broken_goldens: 225 golden images clean   (severity: error, 1 documented residual excluded)
Gates: 3 passed, 3 warned, 20 skipped  → exit 0

so the detector flip itself is sound — only the ratchet thresholds (30.0, measured on 0.11.x) don't transfer to the 0.14.x census. Re-measure and repin via the owner-exception path (the `--only-down` guard rejects plain raises), or reconcile the analyzer change upstream first.

### Thread 3 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
💡 **SUGGESTION: harden the JSON violation schema access**

Two small robustness nits in the new JSON path:

1. `v["file"]` raises `KeyError` (traceback, not the script's `SystemExit` idiom) if a future report omits the key. `v.get("file", "")` degrades gracefully and still counts the violation via `setdefault(Path("").name, ...)` — or skip the entry.

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CRAP ratchet config guards (issue #433).

Three checks over every `crap4dart.yaml` in the repo:

1. Badge sync (AC1): the README shields badge for a package must encode
   the SAME threshold as that package's `crap4dart.yaml`
   (`CRAP%20max-<N>` for the core, `CRAP%20app-<N>` for flutter_app).
   They drifted once already (badge 8.0 vs threshold 12.0).
2. Exclude parity (E1): both configs must exclude the same generated-code
   patterns, so generated drift cannot open a CRAP hole in one package.
3. Only-down (AC3): a config's `crap.threshold` may never RISE above the
   threshold recorded in git history at the base ref — the ratchet, like
   the coverage baseline, goes only down. New config files (bootstrap)
   are allowed. ONE sanctioned escape: a config whose file carries a
   `# raise-issue: gh-<N>` comment (linking the open restore issue) may
   rise temporarily — the issue is the compensation (owner policy:
   red-on-main gates get a documented raise + a restore issue, never a
   silent config edit).

Usage:
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py                 # badge + parity
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down SHA # + git-history guard
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py --self-test     # fixture checks

Exit 0 = all green, 1 = any guard failed, 2 = usage error.
"""

import argparse
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

# package key -> (config path relative to repo root, README badge marker).
# The badge URL encodes the threshold as .../badge/<marker><value>-<color>.
# ponytail: fixed map, not discovery — adding a third package is one entry
# plus its crap4dart.yaml.
PACKAGES = {
    "core": ("crap4dart.yaml", "CRAP%20max-"),
    "flutter_app": ("flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml", "CRAP%20app-"),
}

README = "README.md"

# Generated-code exclude patterns that MUST be present in every package's
# config (E1). Extra package-specific excludes (e.g. core's vendor/**)
# are allowed and unchecked.
GENERATED_EXCLUDES = {"**.g.dart", "**.freezed.dart", "**.mocks.dart", "build/**"}

# Sanctioned temporary-raise marker (AC3 escape hatch): a config carrying
# `# raise-issue: gh-<N>` may rise above its base-ref threshold — the linked
# open issue is the restore commitment (owner policy, see docstring AC3).
RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER = re.compile(r"#\s*raise-issue:\s*(?:gh-)?\d+")


def parse_config(path: Path):
    """Returns (threshold, excludes) or None when the file does not exist.

    crap4dart 0.2.1 rejects unknown keys, so a `threshold:` line in a
    valid config can only be `crap.threshold`; the `exclude:` block is
    the top-level list. A line-walker beats a yaml dependency here.
    """
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    threshold = None
    excludes = []
    in_exclude = False
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = raw.split("#", 1)[0].rstrip()
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if not line[0].isspace():
            in_exclude = line.strip() == "exclude:"
            continue
        # crap4dart 0.2.1 allows `threshold:` only under `crap:`, so an
        # indented `threshold:` line IS the CRAP threshold.
        m = re.fullmatch(r"threshold:\s*([0-9.]+)\s*", line.strip())
        if m:
            threshold = float(m.group(1))
        elif in_exclude:
            m = re.fullmatch(r'-\s+["\']?(.+?)["\']?\s*', line.strip())
            if m:
                excludes.append(m.group(1))
    if threshold is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: no `threshold:` found — malformed config?")
    return threshold, frozenset(excludes)


def read_threshold_at(ref: str, rel_path: str):
    """Threshold of `rel_path` as of git `ref`, or None when absent there."""
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"{ref}:{rel_path}"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return None
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".yaml", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(proc.stdout)
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        return parse_config(tmp_path)[0]
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink()


def check_badges(root: Path):
    """AC1: every existing config's threshold must match its README badge."""
    readme = (root / README).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    failures = []
    checked = 0
    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: no badge for {name} (expected .../badge/"
                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"
            )
            continue
        badge = float(m.group(1))
        if badge != threshold:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"
            )
    return checked, failures


def check_exclude_parity(root: Path):
    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )
    return found_any, failures


def check_only_down(root: Path, base_ref: str):
    """AC3: no config's threshold may rise above its base-ref value."""
    failures = []
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        current = parse_config(root / rel)
        if current is None:
            continue
        base = read_threshold_at(base_ref, rel)
        if base is None:
            continue  # new config (bootstrap) — nothing recorded yet
        if current[0] > base + 1e-9:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):
                continue  # sanctioned temporary raise — restore issue linked
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: threshold rose {base} -> {current[0]} since {base_ref} "
                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )
    return failures


def self_test():
    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)

        def write(readme_badge, yaml_threshold, excludes=GENERATED_EXCLUDES):
            (root / README).write_text(
                f"[![x](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAP%20max-{readme_badge}"
                f"-brightgreen)](https://example.com)\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
                "sources: [lib]\n"
                "exclude:\n"
                + "".join(f"  - '{p}'\n" for p in sorted(excludes))
                + f"crap:\n  threshold: {yaml_threshold}\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        # AC1 RED: badge drifted from threshold.
        write("8.0", 12.0)
        _, fails = check_badges(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: badge drift was NOT detected")

        # AC1 GREEN: equal.
        write("12.0", 12.0)
        checked, fails = check_badges(root)
        if fails or checked != 1:
            failures.append(f"self-test: equal badge flagged {fails}")

        # E1: missing generated exclude.
        write("12.0", 12.0, GENERATED_EXCLUDES - {"build/**"})
        _, fails = check_exclude_parity(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: exclude drift was NOT detected")

        # AC3 needs git history: create a repo with a lowered threshold.
        (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
            "sources: [lib]\ncrap:\n  threshold: 12.0\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )
        env_git = ["git", "-C", str(root)]
        for cmd in (
            ["init", "-q"],
            ["config", "user.email", "t@t"],
            ["config", "user.name", "t"],
            ["add", "."],
            ["commit", "-qm", "base"],
        ):
            subprocess.run(env_git + cmd, capture_output=True, check=True)
        subprocess.run(
            env_git + ["mv", "crap4dart.yaml", "base.yaml"], capture_output=True
        )
        (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
            "sources: [lib]\ncrap:\n  threshold: 40.0\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )
        for cmd in (["add", "."], ["commit", "-qm", "raise"]):
            subprocess.run(env_git + cmd, capture_output=True, check=True)
        raised = check_only_down(root, "HEAD~1")
        if not raised:
            failures.append("self-test: threshold raise was NOT detected")
        # The same diff lowered (40 -> 12 reversed) must pass.
        (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
            "sources: [lib]\ncrap:\n  threshold: 12.0\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )
        lowered = check_only_down(root, "HEAD~1")
        if lowered:
            failures.append(f"self-test: lowering flagged: {lowered}")

    if failures:
        print("\n".join(failures))
        return 1
    print("self-test OK: badge sync, exclude parity, only-down all verified")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--only-down",
        metavar="BASE_REF",
        help="also assert thresholds did not rise since BASE_REF (git history)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--self-test", action="store_true", help="run fixture checks and exit"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    root = Path(subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    ).stdout.strip())

    failures = []
    checked, badge_fails = check_badges(root)
    if checked:
        print(f"badge sync: {checked} config/badge pair(s) checked")
    failures += badge_fails
    found, parity_fails = check_exclude_parity(root)
    if found:
        print("exclude parity: generated patterns asserted in every config")
    failures += parity_fails
    if args.only_down:
        failures += check_only_down(root, args.only_down)

    if failures:
        print("\n".join(f"❌ {f}" for f in failures), file=sys.stderr)
        print("CRAP config guards FAILED", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("✅ CRAP config guards OK (badge sync, exclude parity"
          + (", only-down" if args.only_down else "") + ")")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:

- **Title**: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

- **Deletions**: -39
- **Created**: 2026-10-15T20:12:00Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-16T23:42:31Z

## PR Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

The 12.0 threshold (and the flutter_app 30.0) were measured on the 0.11.x census. crap4dart 0.14.2 changed the census semantics — the two offenders measure CC 9 at 0.0% coverage here (both under 0.11.x kept the repo at ≤ 12.0 on the same merged lcov; `parseTuiMouseMode` is a switch *expression* whose or-patterns now appear to count as branches, and/or the lcov coverage join now attributes 0% to functions the old version credited). `analyze` then exits 2, which also means the downstream `Quality gates (check --baseline)` step never ran in CI (I ran it locally on 0.14.2: it passes — loc + duplication baseline + broken_goldens 4/4 — so the ratchet is the only red).

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):

# pr-1637: broken_goldens: flip to error on crap4dart >=0.14.2 (upstream IstiN/crap4dart#3/#4 fixed)

## Description

## What

crap4dart 0.14.1 + 0.14.2 fixed the broken_goldens detector bugs this repo pinned in issue #447's follow-ups ([IstiN/crap4dart#3](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/3), [#4](https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart/issues/4) — both closed):

- **blind spots**: hollow icon boxes (unloaded icon font) and solid glyph rectangle runs (Ahem fallback text) are now detected;
- **false positives**: checkmark-tile V vs tofu X (full converge→merge→diverge cycle, corner-anchored diagonals), yellow-on-dark digits (checkerboard equal-length segments), copy-icon panels (ring isolation), rounded unchecked checkboxes (square-corner + 20 px floor).

## Changes

- `crap4dart.yaml` + `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: `broken_goldens.severity: warning → error`; the six old excludes are fixed upstream and dropped; one documented residual exclude remains (`onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` — the white dock-tile row is geometrically identical to Ahem text; no shape-only discriminator).
- `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`: parse the detector's **JSON** output — the console report truncates at 20 violations ("... and N more"), which silently halved the regression count (printed 0/40 with 20 detected); `classify` maps any detection to the fixtures' `detect` bucket (the artifact word stays as display detail); regression note states the measured truth.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: bounded pin `>=0.11.0 <0.12.0` → `>=0.14.2 <0.15.0` in both CRAP-ratchet jobs — the flipped configs rely on the 0.14.2 detector; 0.11.0 would flag the six fixed FP goldens as errors.

## Measured (crap4dart 0.14.2 from pub.dev)

- `python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed --regression` → **MET**, regression fixture **30/40** detected (0/40 before 0.14.1; residual: sub-20 px hollow boxes deliberately not flagged — indistinguishable from 16–18 px rounded checkboxes, the `fa_mark` logo (a real image), and sub-glyph-scale text).
- `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`: **221/221 golden images clean** at severity error.
- core `crap4dart.yaml`: 4/4 clean.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CRAP ratchet config guards (issue #433).

Three checks over every `crap4dart.yaml` in the repo:

1. Badge sync (AC1): the README shields badge for a package must encode
   the SAME threshold as that package's `crap4dart.yaml`
   (`CRAP%20max-<N>` for the core, `CRAP%20app-<N>` for flutter_app).
   They drifted once already (badge 8.0 vs threshold 12.0).
2. Exclude parity (E1): both configs must exclude the same generated-code
   patterns, so generated drift cannot open a CRAP hole in one package.
3. Only-down (AC3): a config's `crap.threshold` may never RISE above the
   threshold recorded in git history at the base ref — the ratchet, like
   the coverage baseline, goes only down. New config files (bootstrap)
   are allowed. ONE sanctioned escape: a config whose file carries a
   `# raise-issue: gh-<N>` comment (linking the open restore issue) may
   rise temporarily — the issue is the compensation (owner policy:
   red-on-main gates get a documented raise + a restore issue, never a
   silent config edit).

Usage:
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py                 # badge + parity
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down SHA # + git-history guard
  python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py --self-test     # fixture checks

Exit 0 = all green, 1 = any guard failed, 2 = usage error.
"""

import argparse
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

# package key -> (config path relative to repo root, README badge marker).
# The badge URL encodes the threshold as .../badge/<marker><value>-<color>.
# ponytail: fixed map, not discovery — adding a third package is one entry
# plus its crap4dart.yaml.
PACKAGES = {
    "core": ("crap4dart.yaml", "CRAP%20max-"),
    "flutter_app": ("flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml", "CRAP%20app-"),
}

README = "README.md"

# Generated-code exclude patterns that MUST be present in every package's
# config (E1). Extra package-specific excludes (e.g. core's vendor/**)
# are allowed and unchecked.
GENERATED_EXCLUDES = {"**.g.dart", "**.freezed.dart", "**.mocks.dart", "build/**"}

# Sanctioned temporary-raise marker (AC3 escape hatch): a config carrying
# `# raise-issue: gh-<N>` may rise above its base-ref threshold — the linked
# open issue is the restore commitment (owner policy, see docstring AC3).
RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER = re.compile(r"#\s*raise-issue:\s*(?:gh-)?\d+")


def parse_config(path: Path):
    """Returns (threshold, excludes) or None when the file does not exist.

    crap4dart 0.2.1 rejects unknown keys, so a `threshold:` line in a
    valid config can only be `crap.threshold`; the `exclude:` block is
    the top-level list. A line-walker beats a yaml dependency here.
    """
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    threshold = None
    excludes = []
    in_exclude = False
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = raw.split("#", 1)[0].rstrip()
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if not line[0].isspace():
            in_exclude = line.strip() == "exclude:"
            continue
        # crap4dart 0.2.1 allows `threshold:` only under `crap:`, so an
        # indented `threshold:` line IS the CRAP threshold.
        m = re.fullmatch(r"threshold:\s*([0-9.]+)\s*", line.strip())
        if m:
            threshold = float(m.group(1))
        elif in_exclude:
            m = re.fullmatch(r'-\s+["\']?(.+?)["\']?\s*', line.strip())
            if m:
                excludes.append(m.group(1))
    if threshold is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"{path}: no `threshold:` found — malformed config?")
    return threshold, frozenset(excludes)


def read_threshold_at(ref: str, rel_path: str):
    """Threshold of `rel_path` as of git `ref`, or None when absent there."""
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "show", f"{ref}:{rel_path}"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        return None
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".yaml", delete=False) as tmp:
        tmp.write(proc.stdout)
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        return parse_config(tmp_path)[0]
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink()


def check_badges(root: Path):
    """AC1: every existing config's threshold must match its README badge."""
    readme = (root / README).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    failures = []
    checked = 0
    for name, (rel, marker) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue  # package not bootstrapped yet — nothing to assert
        checked += 1
        threshold = cfg[0]
        m = re.search(re.escape(marker) + r"([0-9.]+)", readme)
        if m is None:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: no badge for {name} (expected .../badge/"
                f"{marker}<threshold>) while {rel} pins {threshold}"
            )
            continue
        badge = float(m.group(1))
        if badge != threshold:
            failures.append(
                f"{README}: {name} badge says CRAP {badge} but {rel} "
                f"pins {threshold} — sync them"
            )
    return checked, failures


def check_exclude_parity(root: Path):
    """E1: both configs must carry the same generated-code exclude set."""
    failures = []
    found_any = False
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        cfg = parse_config(root / rel)
        if cfg is None:
            continue
        found_any = True
        missing = GENERATED_EXCLUDES - cfg[1]
        if missing:
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: generated-code excludes drifted — missing {sorted(missing)} "
                f"(must match the other package's generated set)"
            )
    return found_any, failures


def check_only_down(root: Path, base_ref: str):
    """AC3: no config's threshold may rise above its base-ref value."""
    failures = []
    for name, (rel, _) in PACKAGES.items():
        current = parse_config(root / rel)
        if current is None:
            continue
        base = read_threshold_at(base_ref, rel)
        if base is None:
            continue  # new config (bootstrap) — nothing recorded yet
        if current[0] > base + 1e-9:
            text = (root / rel).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            if RAISE_ISSUE_MARKER.search(text):
                continue  # sanctioned temporary raise — restore issue linked
            failures.append(
                f"{rel}: threshold rose {base} -> {current[0]} since {base_ref} "
                f"— the CRAP ratchet is only-down; fix code, not config "
                f"(or link a restore issue via `# raise-issue: gh-<N>`)"
            )
    return failures


def self_test():
    """Fixture-driven checks for every guard mode (AC1 RED/GREEN, E1, AC3)."""
    failures = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)

        def write(readme_badge, yaml_threshold, excludes=GENERATED_EXCLUDES):
            (root / README).write_text(
                f"[![x](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAP%20max-{readme_badge}"
                f"-brightgreen)](https://example.com)\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (root / "crap4dart.yaml").write_text(
                "sources: [lib]\n"
                "exclude:\n"
                + "".join(f"  - '{p}'\n" for p in sorted(excludes))
                + f"crap:\n  threshold: {yaml_threshold}\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        # AC1 RED: badge drifted from threshold.
        write("8.0", 12.0)
        _, fails = check_badges(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: badge drift was NOT detected")

        # AC1 GREEN: equal.
        write("12.0", 12.0)
        checked, fails = check_badges(root)
        if fails or checked != 1:
            failures.append(f"self-test: equal badge flagged {fails}")

        # E1: missing generated exclude.
        write("12.0", 12.0, GENERATED_EXCLUDES - {"build/**"})
        _, fails = check_exclude_parity(root)
        if not fails:
            failures.append("self-test: exclude drift was NOT detected")
